name: datafog
description: Locally replaces detected personal data and selected credentials with reversible markers in Claude Code files and tool output. Uses an encrypted local vault. Requires a supported Mac or Linux machine; coverage and failure-mode limits apply.

keep_vault_on_uninstall.title: Keep the vault when the plugin is uninstalled
keep_vault_on_uninstall.description: On: the encrypted vault (the table that turns markers back into your real values) is stored in your user data folder and survives an uninstall, and its key stays in your key store. Off: it is stored in the plugin's data folder, which Claude Code deletes on uninstall; markers left in your files can then never be restored.

unscannable_file_policy.title: Files that cannot be checked
unscannable_file_policy.description: What to do when Claude reads a file DataFog cannot check (images, PDFs, binary or very large files): ask you each time, deny the read, or allow it unchecked.

entities.title: Entity types to detect
entities.description: Comma-separated list, or empty for the default set (EMAIL, PHONE, SSN, CREDIT_CARD, API_KEY, BEARER_TOKEN, JWT, PRIVATE_KEY, CREDENTIAL_URI, US_ROUTING_NUMBER, NPI, ACCOUNT_NUMBER). Also available, noisy in code: DATE, IP_ADDRESS, ZIP_CODE, STREET_ADDRESS, UUID.
